name: Fei Changgui Fangsongbu Mika & Luna
original_name: 非常规放送部 Mika & Luna
source:
A modern world where humans and demons coexist—the energetic gal Mika and sharp-tongued gamer Luna are forced to stay in the human world by a 500-million debt! This free visual novel updates in anime-style chapters. Join their hilarious adventures and uncover a mysterious otherworld's truth!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4583050/%E9%9D%9E%E5%B8%B8%E8%A7%84%E6%94%BE%E9%80%81%E9%83%A8_Mika_Luna/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个人类与魔人共存的现代世界里——元气满满的辣妹米卡与毒舌游戏宅露娜因背负高达5亿的巨额债务，被迫滞留在人间！这部完全免费的视觉小说将以动画番剧般的章节形式持续更新。加入她们爆笑不断的日常冒险，一同揭开神秘异界背后的真相吧！
